title: Entity Gap Matrix
short: Compare your entity coverage against up to three competitors. Names are normalised before anything is compared — the step most gap analyses skip, and the reason most of them are wrong.
needs: Nothing — no API calls at all
inputs: One entity export for you, and one for each competitor
outputs: A shared / missing / unique / thin matrix, exportable as CSV
how: Load your own corpus into the first slot.
Add up to three competitors. Pick them for comparability, not for ranking.
Press Compare, then read the four verdicts.
Filter to missing, and require two or more competitors before you act.
Export, and use it to score Coverage.
note: Filter chrome and generic nouns out of every corpus first, not just your own — otherwise the top “gap” will be a word like “content”.
